summary: PR partially matches the ticket; blocking issues below.

findings.title: Missing null guard
findings.problem: `item` can be null when the list is empty, which throws on render.
findings.solution: Use optional chaining or an early return: `if (!item) return null` before accessing `item.id`.

findings.title: N+1 query risk
findings.problem: Loop calls repository.findOne for each id.
findings.solution: Load all ids in one `In([...])` query, then map in memory.
